desc:
🏛️ You start with nothing and can end up in the Planalto Palace... or get kicked out of it! 

This game is a political and governance simulator for Brazil, and it has several features:
🗳️ CAMPAIGN: win over the people and spread your face across the city. 
🎤 TV DEBATE: leave your rivals speechless on stage. 
👑 ELECTION: compete for a seat as a Deputy, Senator or President. Every vote counts! 
📜 POWER: create laws, vote in the plenary, approve or veto. 
⚖️ IMPEACHMENT: ruled poorly? The House can impeach you LIVE! 
🚩 YOUR PARTY: choose a name, color, and symbol and build the largest team on the server with your friends! 

🆕 NEWS 
📢 Outdoor to support your election campaign 
🎨 New party colors and symbols 

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite to help the game grow! 
🔔 Press NOTIFY to stay up-to-date first. 

Only you can be the President you want for Brazil. Come and show that you can be the face of Brazilian History!

Parties, politicians and game laws are fictional.
